Early Pantheon lane-bully window (1-4), flip at 6 when his W dash feeds Vex's passive, hard Vex scaling after items — matches kits and the packet chart exactly.
Content spikes are unusually good and enemy-specific; kept intact except two mechanical claims (see point 4).

audit.why: Riot text for Mortal Will and Aegis Assault; Vex R carries the projectile flag.
audit.corrected: Passive claims rewritten to the empowered-spell tell; E claims replaced with wait-out-the-22s-Aegis advice.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shield Vault (Stun) is 13-9s: point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up, and take your trade in the seconds after he burns it. - Aegis Assault runs 22-18s; never dump your combo into the raised shield. - Your W is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: His Shield Vault is a dash — the leap marks him and loads your fear, so the safest trade in the lane is the one that starts the instant he lands on you.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Pantheon falls off two items in — an R hoarded past the skirmish that mattered is the execute window he was praying you would not open on time.

edits.before: Q-poke the last-hits — the accelerating bolt chips from a deceptive range and Gloom marks tax every connect.
edits.after: His empowered Comet Spear costs 25 mana and hits hard at level 1 — last-hit with Q from range and refuse the auto war.

edits.before: W online: the shield-fear pulse means anyone who dashes onto you regrets the itinerary.
edits.after: His W leap-stun into empowered Q bursts through your fresh shield — stand behind minions he must walk around.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: Full kit for him too: Q-W-E all-in beats your kit before 6 — trade only right after Shield Vault is spent.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: His kill pressure and roam threat still exceed yours — bank Lost Chapter gold and hold even in CS.

edits.before: Pantheon's point-blank empowered Q and passive auto-block beat your level-1 trade.
edits.after: Pantheon's point-blank empowered Q off Mortal Will beats your level-1 trade.

edits.before: Pantheon owns levels 1-4. His passive blocks your autos, his Q outranges your trade range at melee, and his W leap-stun sets up a burst combo your W shield can't fully eat. Do not contest early — soak XP behind your minions, last-hit with Q, and give up a little CS rather than a kill. Ward your flanks because he roams well with a lead.
edits.after: Pantheon owns levels 1-4. Mortal Will empowers a spell every few attacks, his 25-mana Q is free harass, and his W leap-stun sets up a burst your W shield can't fully eat. Do not contest early — soak XP behind minions, last-hit with Q, and give up a little CS rather than a kill. Ward your flanks; he roams well with a lead.

edits.before: The lane flips at 6. His E can block your Q but not your ult: Shadow Surge marks him and slows, and when he commits his W leap-stun onto you, that dash procs your Gloom passive for a hard interrupt-fear. Bait the leap, W-shield, fear him, and you win the exchange he used to win.
edits.after: The lane flips at 6. His E blocks everything from the front for its channel — wait out the 22s Aegis rather than feeding it your combo. When he commits his W leap-stun onto you, that dash procs your Gloom passive for a hard interrupt-fear: bait the leap, W-shield, fear him, and win the exchange he used to win.

edits.before: At 6 the matchup inverts. His E blocks a lot but your Shadow Surge ignores it and his signature W leap-stun is a dash that triggers your Gloom interrupt-fear. Let him initiate, absorb with W, and punish the leap with an empowered fear into your combo. Once your first item lands you outrange his poke and hold real kill threat with R.
edits.after: At 6 the matchup inverts. His E blocks frontal damage — including your Q and R missiles — so never burst into the raised shield; wait out its 22s cooldown. His signature W leap-stun is a dash that triggers your Gloom interrupt-fear: let him initiate, absorb with W, punish the leap with the empowered fear, then combo.
